# Blockbench MCP

Maintained by Josshy, based on the original plugin by Jason J. Gardner.
Repository: https://github.com/ItsJosshy/blockbench-mcp-plugin
License: GPL-3.0-only; see LICENSE. Preserve original contributor credits.

Blockbench MCP runs a local Model Context Protocol server in desktop Blockbench.
It exposes tools, resources and prompts for geometry, textures, painting,
animation, project inspection, history and export. Hytale integration requires
the Hytale Models plugin. There is no built-in LLM chat client.

Read AGENTS.md, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, VERSIONING.md and CHANGELOG.md before
contributing. package.json is the only editable version source.
docs/api.json is the generated schema inventory. docs/experimental-review.md
records promotion evidence and blockers for every remaining experimental tool.

Build with Bun 1.3.8: bun install --frozen-lockfile, then bun run build.
Load dist/mcp.js through File > Plugins > Load Plugin from File and reconnect
the client to http://127.0.0.1:3000/bb-mcp (or the configured endpoint).
The maintained deployment is:
https://itsjosshy.github.io/blockbench-mcp-plugin/nightly/mcp.js
An unmerged local version is available only through the locally built file.

Tests: bun run test; bun run typecheck; bun run docs:build.
Live checks: bun run test:live and bun run test:stability:live.
Use disposable projects and preserve existing models and Undo histories.
Verify native API behavior against the actual Blockbench version.
